item: Home's refresh and the cache warm-up stop when memory is short; trending ranks lazily (diagnostics rank 4)
summary: warm_cache runs under the statement deadline (5x the endpoint budget, OO_WARM_DEADLINE_S) and the memory stop; only Home's refresh asks run_all_bounded(memory_stop=True), says why via truncated_reason and keeps the cached feed, marked kept and not ledgered as a refresh; trending ranks lazily over a heap with a full-sort fallback (tracemalloc peak 484.7 MB to 0.1 MB, 21.3 s to 8.0 s at 2.2M synthetic keywords).
